RRB Paramedical CEN 05/2026 Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 590 Nursing Superintendent, Pharmacist and More Posts - Complete Details

Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for 590 Paramedical posts. The online application process will be conducted from 15 September 2026 to 14 October 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Online Registration Start Date : 15.09.2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online : 14.10.2026 (23:59 hrs)
  • Date of Indicative Notice in Employment News : 12.09.2026

  • Closing Date for Submission of Online Application : 14.10.2026 (23:59 hrs)

  • Window for Eligible Scribe Candidates to Provide Scribe Details : 27.10.2026 to 31.10.2026
  • CBT Exam Date : Not specified in the notification; to be communicated later on the RRB website
  • All other candidates (General) : ₹500

Application Fee

  • Posts : 9 Paramedical posts (Nursing Superintendent, Dialysis Technician, Health & Malaria Inspector Gr II, Audiologist & Speech Therapist, Pharmacist, Radiographer X-Ray Technician, ECG Technician, Optometrist, Lab Assistant Gr II)

  • Post : Minimum Educational Qualification
  • Audiologist & Speech Therapist : Bachelor in Audiology, Speech Language Pathology (BASLP) from a recognised University, registered with the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI)
  • Pharmacist (Entry Grade) : Bachelor Degree in Pharmacy (Allopathic) or Doctor of Pharmacy from a recognised University/Institute, registered as Pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948
  • Optometrist : B.Sc. in Optometry or Diploma in Ophthalmic Technician (3–4 year course), with registration from the concerned Council/Licensing body
  • Lab Assistant Gr. II : 12th (10+2) in Science plus Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT) or an equivalent Certificate Course (minimum 1-year, full-time) (B.Sc. Medical Lab Technology also eligible)

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
